prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one ORIGINAL MASTER painting for one Bhagavad Gita verse in a Sanskrit reader. Generate a single square 1:1 image, 2048x2048 or the highest actually supported native square resolution. Consistent series style: refined traditional Indian watercolor and restrained gouache on warm ivory handmade paper; fine organic detail, subtle ochre, sage, dusty terracotta and muted indigo; dignified ancient Indian setting, quiet atmospheric daylight. The image must illustrate THIS VERSE'S ACTUAL MEANING. Read the exact source meaning below; derive a concrete, intelligible scene or a restrained symbolic interpretation of that teaching. Never simply paint an unrelated chariot, generic temple or anonymous landscape. Compose one coherent scene, no collage or infographic. Keep important faces, hands, relationships and narrative objects inside the central 60% of width and central 50% of height, surrounded by ample low-detail sky, ground and paper atmosphere. No important subject cut by an edge. This one master must support portrait/landscape phones and tablets through safe proportional fitting. No text of any kind, no verse number, no letters, no Sanskrit/Roman typography, no watermark, no frame, no UI. Text will be rendered separately by the app over the image at a user-adjustable default image opacity of 48%. If Krishna is depicted, maintain a youthful calm blue-skinned figure in muted golden-yellow garments, a restrained peacock-feather crown, no modern jewelry. Arjuna is a dark-haired warrior with a small crown, bow and understated bronze armor. Use them only when the meaning warrants them; the scene or analogy remains verse-specific.  Reference (DO NOT DRAW THIS TEXT): Bhagavad Gītā 11.41. Exact Sanskrit: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं
हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति ।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं
मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि ॥ ४१ ॥ Exact stored meaning: Whatever I have said rashly — treating You as a friend, without knowing this greatness of Yours — 'O Kṛṣṇa! O Yādava! O my friend!' — whether from carelessness or from love — Chapter context: The universal vision granted to Arjuna. Follow the verse-specific appearance, emotional response or prayer. Awe and cosmic scale, but no gore or graphic violence; when cosmic destruction is stated, use symbolic silhouettes and radiance. Previous verse context only, do not substitute for the target: Salutation from the front and from behind! O All (Sarva), salutation from every side! O You of infinite valor and boundless might — You pervade everything, and therefore You are everything. Next verse context only, do not substitute for the target: During our sports, our resting, our sitting, and our meals — alone or even in the presence of others — O Acyuta (the unfaltering)! — for whatever disrespect was shown through jesting or insult, I ask forgiveness of You, the Immeasurable (Aprameyam). Final instruction: center the distinctive content of the TARGET meaning, not the neighboring verses. No fabricated teaching or unrelated religious scene.
review_note: Contact-sheet inspection; conservative full-frame safe region preserves all figures and objects.
